name: Slavia
notes: 2026 facelift. 5-star Global NCAP rating. 1.0 TSI with 6-speed MT or 8-speed AT; 1.5 TSI with 7-speed DSG.

name: Kodiaq
notes: Second generation. 2.0 TSI petrol, 7-speed DSG, 4x4. Lounge is a 5-seater; Sportline and Selection L&K are 7-seaters.

notes: Not yet launched in India. Price, battery and range are indicative media estimates, not official figures.
